questions.explain: The Canaanites took the mourning company of Israel for Egyptians.

questions.q: What did Joseph answer when his brothers feared he would requite them?
choices: Now you will be my servants
Fear not: am I in the place of God? Ye thought evil, but God meant it unto good
questions.explain: He comforted them and spake kindly unto them; always keep that spirit of forgiveness.
He saw the children of Ephraim of the third generation.

questions.q: Why can no one show the mummy of Joseph?
choices: Israel carried his bones out of Egypt, according to his oath
questions.explain: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him (Exodus 13:19).
